title: Tail bound for low degree functions
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with Fourier degree at most $k$, where $k\in\mathbb N$. For real numbers $q,t$ with $2\le q$ and $t>0$, if the uniform $L^2$ norm of $f$ is positive, then $\Pr[t\|f\|_2\le |f(x)|]\le (q^{k/2}/t)^q$ for uniformly random $x$ in the cube.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
